title: Prop legs clear a SUPERSET of the ladder: guard + bybit_1 soak for trend_donchian_{eth,sol}_prop (stay live on prop meanwhile)
note: OPERATOR DECISION 2026-10-15 (chat, verbatim 'Yes, 1, 2 and 3a'; principle: 'if anything, the prop accounts should have a higher bar to clear because of the DD limits'). (1) RULE: a prop leg clears everything a real-money leg clears (Stage 0 net of full cost, Stage-1 soak with realized cost matching, Gate 2) PLUS the prop EV/survival gate -- written into OPERATING-PLAN §2, CLAUDE.md ladder, ARCHITECTURE-CANONICAL, prop-accounts DESIGN, strategies.yaml comments; guard prop-roster-gate-guard (scripts/ci/check_prop_roster_gate.py) fails a prop-roster add without a Stage-1 soak AND comms/prop_survival/<leg>.json; trend_donchian_eth_prop (due 2026-11-07) and trend_donchian_sol_prop (due 2026-12-11) grandfathered BY NAME. (2) Both legs added to the bybit_1 roster (paper, Stage-1 soak), contracts SOAK-stage1-bybit_1-<leg> in SOAKS.json (pass: R3 cost-fidelity within 2 bps + live-vs-backtest consistency via scripts/research/live_vs_backtest.py, PR #18382 -- referenced, not on main at write time). bybit_2/bybit_portfolio/alpaca untouched. (3a) Both legs STAY LIVE on breakout_2/tradeify_1/velotrade_1 while the soak accrues. If either FAILS the soak, propose pulling it from prop rosters (data-backed Tier-3). Hold PR; manager merges. Merged != deployed != observed: close only on the observation below.
